title: RepairScheme
description: An executable sequence of coded broadcasts that delivers every moving piece in a SplitMergePlan. Decodability (transmitter stores all terms; every receiver holds all other terms as side information) and delivery coverage are enforced by verifyRepair in verifier.mjs.

by.description: Transmitting node. Must store every term it XORs and must not be the removed node.

terms.description: Piece ids XOR-combined into this one transmission. A single-term broadcast is an uncoded send.

size.description: Optional. Transmission size = max term size (zero-padded XOR). If given, it is checked against the computed value.
